The program supports innovative pilot projects across four key industrial application tracks, offering real-world testing environments and resources for capacity building. Impact Hub Network Facebook Twitter LinkedIn

Whether you’re solving climate challenges through carbon dioxide removal (CDR), carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS), low-duration energy storage (LDES), or new approaches to carbon innovation — this is your call to action.

Play Introducing the CarbonX Program 2.0 Launched by Tencent, Impact Hub Network, and its global partners, the CarbonX Program 2.0 is a global program that provides tens of millions of USD in catalytic grants, plus mentorship, resources, and real-world pilot opportunities — all to help innovators like you scale and deploy next-gen carbon solutions where it matters most.

Receive: ✅ Up to several million USD per pilot project ✅ Real-world pilot opportunities in industrial settings ✅ Expert mentorship and global partnerships The world needs carbon innovation that can scale rapidly and create tangible, lasting impact on the climate.
We’ll kick off with a panel discussion featuring voices from across the investment landscape, followed by an exclusive look into Tencent’s CarbonX Program 2.0 for climate tech ventures.

The event will close with a Q&A session featuring a Tencent representative and a past participant from their programme, offering real-world insights into what it takes to unlock capital and scale climate innovation. 🗓️ 16 May 2025 🕒 12PM – 1:30PM CET 👉 Join here Choose a session, join us, and take the first step toward transforming your innovation into global impact.

How Nepal is turning circular with the Roots of Circularity programme | Impact Hub Skip to content About us Our story Our methodology Meet the team Impact Hub locations Work with us Our services For Corporates For Public Sector For Entrepreneurs Our work Our Impact Impact stories Impact resources Media & PR Join us Start an Impact Hub Impact Maker Membership Impact Report Impact Report 2025-26 Impact Report 2024-25 Impact Report 2023-24 Impact Report 2022-23 Impact Report 2021-22 About us Our story Our methodology Meet the team Impact Hub locations Work with us Our services For Corporates For Public Sector For Entrepreneurs Our work Our Impact Impact stories Impact resources Media & PR Join us Start an Impact Hub Impact Maker Membership Impact Report Impact Report 2025-26 Impact Report 2024-25 Impact Report 2023-24 Impact Report 2022-23 Impact Report 2021-22 How Nepal is turning circular with the Roots of Circularity programme Nepal is embracing a regenerative future and the Roots of Circularity programme is leading the way. From empowering small businesses to embedding sustainable practices, to integrating circular economy thinking into national education and policy, this transformative initiative is building a more resilient, inclusive, and sustainable Nepal, one system shift at a time. Impact Hub Network Global team Facebook Twitter LinkedIn WhatsApp In a world facing

As a country rich in natural beauty but vulnerable to climate change and resource scarcity, Nepal has much to gain by embracing systems that conserve resources, reduce environmental pressure, and empower communities.
The programme is being implemented across Bagmati and Lumbini Provinces, working with local stakeholders to catalyse change across education, enterprise, civil society, and government.
To date, the programme has supported 30 MSMEs across three incubation cohorts in Bagmati and Lumbini, offering training, mentorship, and resources tailored to help businesses adopt circular models.
Mainstreaming circularity in education To secure long-term change, RoC is embedding circular economy thinking into Nepal’s formal education system, from secondary schools to higher education.
That’s why RoC is focused on strengthening partnerships across government, civil society, and the private sector.
The road ahead Nepal’s journey toward a circular economy is just beginning but it is already gaining ground through entrepreneurship, education, public engagement, and policy reform.
